en: Do you know the story of the very thirsty dog?
Our beloved Prophet, <SAW>, told us this story.
A man was walking on a hot, hot day, and he was very thirsty.
He found a well, climbed down, and drank the cool water.
When he came up, he saw a dog, so thirsty it was licking the wet ground.
So the man climbed down again, filled his shoe with water, and gave the dog a drink.
Allah was pleased with him, and forgave him!
Being kind to animals brings a reward from Allah.
Who will you be kind to today? A cat, a bird, or a dog?
